text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to implement a maximum of one hour parking limit, from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Woodmount Avenue, between Wolverleigh Boulevard and Strathmore Boulevard. This parking proposal will discourage long-term daytime parking, and promote parking turnover on this section of Woodmount Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking for a maximum period of one hour, from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Woodmount Avenue, between Wolverleigh Boulevard and Strathmore Boulevard. 2. Amended the existing maximum of one hour parking limit, from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., on the west side of Woodmount Avenue, between Danforth Avenue and Wolverleigh Boulevard, to be in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. 3. Amended the existing permit parking regulation in effect at all times, from 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., daily, on the west side of Woodmount Avenue, between Danforth Avenue and Wolverleigh Boulevard, to be in effect from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., daily. 4.
